intro.en: Continents and oceans, natural disasters, and people who move from one country to another.

texto.en:
One common school model groups the world into **cinco continentes**; other models count them differently. There are several **océanos**: el Atlántico, el Pacífico, el Índico. Spain and Portugal share **la península** Ibérica.

Natural hazards include **un terremoto**, **un huracán**, **una inundación**, **una ola de calor**, **una ola de frío** and **granizo**. Spanish says **hubo** un terremoto, with **haber** in the indefinido.

People move. From the country they leave, they **emigran** and are **emigrantes**. From the country they reach, they **inmigran** and are **inmigrantes**. Someone who flees persecution or conflict may be **una persona refugiada** (also **un refugiado**).

Useful verbs: **irse a vivir a**, **cruzar** la frontera, **adaptarse a** otro país, **echar de menos** el suyo, **volver a** su país de origen.

Figures: **la población** de un país; **millones de** personas; **uno de cada diez**.

frases.es: Durante el siglo veinte, millones de españoles emigraron a América y al norte de Europa.
frases.en: During the twentieth century, millions of Spaniards emigrated to the Americas and to northern Europe.
analisis: a América y al norte de Europa

frases.es: Se iban porque en su país no había trabajo.
frases.en: They left because there was no work in their country.

frases.es: Hoy España recibe inmigrantes de otros continentes, sobre todo de América y de África.
frases.en: Today Spain receives immigrants from other continents, above all from the Americas and Africa.
analisis: sobre todo de América y de África

frases.es: Algunos cruzan el océano en avión; otros llegan por mar, en un viaje muy peligroso.
frases.en: Some cross the ocean by plane; others arrive by sea, on a very dangerous journey.

frases.es: Adaptarse a otro país no es fácil: hay que aprender el idioma y se echa de menos a la familia.
frases.en: Adapting to another country is not easy: you have to learn the language and you miss your family.

frases.es: Amal explica que, por ahora, no volvería a su país de origen si allí no tuviera una vida segura.
frases.en: Amal explains that, for now, she would not return to her country of origin if she could not have a safe life there.

Hubo.en: Haber in the indefinido: there was.

Fue.en: Spanish says hubo for an event that took place.

texto.en:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (100–120 words).** Write about migration: why people leave their country, and the experience of someone you know.

**Speak (about 2 minutes).** Tell aloud what you would miss most if you had to live abroad, or what you do miss.
